[[Gabrial Atanna]]'s '''wife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Esselian. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she, along with her grandchildren, were held under house arrest by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after her husband was caught [[Spy/Legends|spying]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. An Alliance team rescued her and the grandchildren and took them to an Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]].
